# `passportsim env`

Change the world around the device: battery, USB, NFC, microphone, Wi-Fi air, HCI bridge.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `core` |
| MCP tool | `passport_env` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/env` |
| Scenario step | `env` |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `needs_instance` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim env [--ble-bridge <BLE_BRIDGE>] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--usb <USB>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `battery` | carried by `--json` | `object` | no | Fuel-gauge values; each field is optional on its own. |
| `ble_bridge` | `--ble-bridge <BLE_BRIDGE>` | `"attach"` \| `"detach"` | no | The external HCI bridge: attach opens a loopback transport a peer connects to and diverts the guest's HCI packets to it; detach gives the guest back to the virtual controller. While it is attached the clock is held at realtime 1.000x. |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `mic` | carried by `--json` | `object` | no | Microphone source. |
| `nfc` | carried by `--json` | `object` | no | Whether a card sits in the reader field. |
| `usb` | `--usb <USB>` | `"unplugged"` \| `"charger"` \| `"host"` \| `"open"` | no | USB world state. |
| `wifi` | carried by `--json` | `object` | no | The scripted access points a Wi-Fi scan finds; replaces the set before. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/env.input.json`](../schema/commands/env.input.json).

## Examples

### Set the cell to 3900 mV at 80 percent

```sh
passportsim env --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "battery": {
    "mv": 3900,
    "soc": 80
  }
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "battery": {
    "mv": 3900,
    "soc": 80
  }
}
'@ | passportsim env --json -
```

### Unplug the USB cable

```sh
passportsim env --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "usb": "unplugged"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "usb": "unplugged"
}
'@ | passportsim env --json -
```

### Put a 440 Hz tone on the microphone

```sh
passportsim env --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "mic": {
    "amplitude": 16384,
    "hz": 440,
    "kind": "tone"
  }
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "mic": {
    "amplitude": 16384,
    "hz": 440,
    "kind": "tone"
  }
}
'@ | passportsim env --json -
```

### Take the NFC card out of the reader field

```sh
passportsim env --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "nfc": {
    "card_present": false
  }
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "nfc": {
    "card_present": false
  }
}
'@ | passportsim env --json -
```

### Attach the external HCI bridge, so a peer drives the controller

```sh
passportsim env --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "ble_bridge": "attach"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "ble_bridge": "attach"
}
'@ | passportsim env --json -
```
